##### Level 3: Sacred Weapon {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level3SacredWeapon}

When you take the [**Attack**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:attackaction "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#attackaction") action, you can expend one use of your Channel Divinity to imbue one Melee weapon that you are holding with positive energy. For 10 minutes or until you use this feature again, you add your Charisma modifier to attack rolls you make with that weapon (minimum bonus of +1), and each time you hit with it, you cause it to deal its normal damage type or Radiant damage.

The weapon also emits [**Bright Light**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:brightlight "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#brightlight") in a 20-foot radius and [**Dim Light**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:dimlight "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#dimlight") 20 feet beyond that.

You can end this effect early (no action required). This effect also ends if you aren’t carrying the weapon.

##### Level 7: Aura of Devotion {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level7AuraofDevotion}

You and your allies have Immunity to the [**Charmed**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:charmedcondition "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#charmedcondition") condition while in your Aura of Protection. If a Charmed ally enters the aura, that condition has no effect on that ally while there.

##### Level 15: Smite of Protection {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level15SmiteofProtection}

Your magical smite now radiates protective energy. Whenever you cast [**Divine Smite**](#ref:spell:2618833-divine-smite "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618833-divine-smite"), you and your allies have [**Half Cover**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:cover "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#cover") while in your Aura of Protection. The aura has this benefit until the start of your next turn.

##### Level 20: Holy Nimbus {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level20HolyNimbus}

As a Bonus Action, you can imbue your Aura of Protection with holy power, granting the benefits below for 10 minutes or until you end them (no action required). Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest"). You can also restore your use of it by expending a level 5 spell slot (no action required).

**_Holy Ward._** You have [**Advantage**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:advantage "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#advantage") on any saving throw you are forced to make by a Fiend or an Undead.

**_Radiant Damage._** Whenever an enemy starts its turn in the aura, that creature takes Radiant damage equal to your Charisma modifier plus your Proficiency Bonus.

**_Sunlight._** The aura is filled with [**Bright Light**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:brightlight "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#brightlight") that is sunlight.

#### Oath of Glory {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:OathofGlory}

_Strive for the Heights of Heroism_

Paladins who take the Oath of Glory believe they and their companions are destined to achieve glory through deeds of heroism. They train diligently and encourage their companions, so they’re all ready when destiny calls.

[![Oath of Glory Subclass (Artist: POLAR ENGINE)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-004.oath-of-glory.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-004.oath-of-glory.png)

These paladins share the following tenets:

- Endeavor to be known by your deeds.
- Face hardships with courage.
- Inspire others to strive for glory.

##### Level 3: Inspiring Smite {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level3InspiringSmite}

Immediately after you cast [**Divine Smite**](#ref:spell:2618833-divine-smite "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618833-divine-smite"), you can expend one use of your Channel Divinity and distribute [**Temporary Hit Points**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:temporaryhitpoints "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#temporaryhitpoints") to creatures of your choice within 30 feet of yourself, which can include you. The total number of Temporary Hit Points equals 2d8 plus your Paladin level, divided among the chosen creatures however you like.

##### Level 3: Oath of Glory Spells {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level3OathofGlorySpells}

The magic of your oath ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Paladin level specified in the Oath of Glory Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

**Oath of Glory Spells**

| Paladin Level | Spells                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 3             | [**Guiding Bolt**](#ref:spell:2619136-guiding-bolt "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619136-guiding-bolt"), [**Heroism**](#ref:spell:2619151-heroism "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619151-heroism")                                               |
| 5             | [**Enhance Ability**](#ref:spell:2619165-enhance-ability "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619165-enhance-ability"), [**Magic Weapon**](#ref:spell:2619024-magic-weapon "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619024-magic-weapon")                       |
| 9             | [**Haste**](#ref:spell:2619141-haste "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619141-haste"), [**Protection from Energy**](#ref:spell:2618908-protection-from-energy "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618908-protection-from-energy")                       |
| 13            | [**Compulsion**](#ref:spell:2619041-compulsion "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619041-compulsion"), [**Freedom of Movement**](#ref:spell:2618921-freedom-of-movement "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618921-freedom-of-movement")                 |
| 17            | [**Legend Lore**](#ref:spell:2619010-legend-lore "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619010-legend-lore"), [**Yolande’s Regal Presence**](#ref:spell:2618842-yolandes-regal-presence "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618842-yolandes-regal-presence") |

##### Level 3: Peerless Athlete {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level3PeerlessAthlete}

As a Bonus Action, you can expend one use of your Channel Divinity to augment your athleticism. For 1 hour, you have [**Advantage**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:advantage "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#advantage") on Strength ([**Athletics**](#phb-2024:playing-the-game:skills "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/playing-the-game#skills")) and Dexterity ([**Acrobatics**](#phb-2024:playing-the-game:skills "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/playing-the-game#skills")) checks, and the distance of your [**Long**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longjump "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longjump") and [**High Jumps**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:highjump "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#highjump") increases by 10 feet (this extra distance costs movement as normal).

##### Level 7: Aura of Alacrity {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level7AuraofAlacrity}

Your Speed increases by 10 feet.

In addition, whenever an ally enters your Aura of Protection for the first time on a turn or starts their turn there, the ally’s Speed increases by 10 feet until the end of their next turn.

##### Level 15: Glorious Defense {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level15GloriousDefense}

You can turn defense into a sudden strike. When you or another creature you can see within 10 feet of you is hit by an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to grant a bonus to the target’s AC against that attack, potentially causing it to miss. The bonus equals your Charisma modifier (minimum of +1). If the attack misses, you can make one attack with a weapon against the attacker as part of this Reaction if the attacker is within your weapon’s range.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest").

##### Level 20: Living Legend {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level20LivingLegend}

You can empower yourself with the legends—whether true or exaggerated—of your great deeds. As a Bonus Action, you gain the benefits below for 10 minutes. Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest"). You can also restore your use of it by expending a level 5 spell slot (no action required).

**_Charismatic._** You are blessed with an otherworldly presence and have [**Advantage**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:advantage "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#advantage") on all Charisma checks.

**_Saving Throw Reroll._** If you fail a saving throw, you can take a Reaction to reroll it. You must use this new roll.

**_Unerring Strike._** Once on each of your turns when you make an attack roll with a weapon and miss, you can cause that attack to hit instead.

#### Oath of the Ancients {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:OathoftheAncients}

_Preserve Life and Light in the World_

The Oath of the Ancients is as old as the first elves. Paladins who swear this oath cherish the light; they love the beautiful and life-giving things of the world more than any principles of honor, courage, and justice. They often adorn their armor and clothing with images of growing things—leaves, antlers, or flowers—to reflect their commitment to preserving life and light.

These paladins share the following tenets:

- Kindle the light of hope.
- Shelter life.
- Delight in art and laughter.

##### Level 3: Nature’s Wrath {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level3NaturesWrath}

As a [**Magic**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:magicaction "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#magicaction") action, you can expend one use of your Channel Divinity to conjure spectral vines around nearby creatures. Each creature of your choice that you can see within 15 feet of yourself must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have the [**Restrained**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:restrainedcondition "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#restrainedcondition") condition for 1 minute. A Restrained creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

##### Level 3: Oath of the Ancients Spells {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level3OathoftheAncientsSpells}

The magic of your oath ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Paladin level specified in the Oath of the Ancients Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

**Oath of the Ancients Spells**

| Paladin Level | Spells                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| 3             | [**Ensnaring Strike**](#ref:spell:2619172-ensnaring-strike "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619172-ensnaring-strike"), [**Speak with Animals**](#ref:spell:2619059-speak-with-animals "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619059-speak-with-animals") |
| 5             | [**Misty Step**](#ref:spell:2619133-misty-step "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619133-misty-step"), [**Moonbeam**](#ref:spell:2619134-moonbeam "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619134-moonbeam")                                                 |
| 9             | [**Plant Growth**](#ref:spell:2618869-plant-growth "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618869-plant-growth"), [**Protection from Energy**](#ref:spell:2618908-protection-from-energy "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618908-protection-from-energy") |
| 13            | [**Ice Storm**](#ref:spell:2619178-ice-storm "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619178-ice-storm"), [**Stoneskin**](#ref:spell:2619095-stoneskin "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619095-stoneskin")                                                 |
| 17            | [**Commune with Nature**](#ref:spell:2618989-commune-with-nature "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618989-commune-with-nature"), [**Tree Stride**](#ref:spell:2619197-tree-stride "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619197-tree-stride")             |

##### Level 7: Aura of Warding {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level7AuraofWarding}

Ancient magic lies so heavily upon you that it forms an eldritch ward, blunting energy from beyond the Material Plane; you and your allies have Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant damage while in your Aura of Protection.

[![Oath of the Ancients Subclass (Artist: POLAR ENGINE)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-005.oath-of-the-ancients.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-005.oath-of-the-ancients.png)

##### Level 15: Undying Sentinel {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level15UndyingSentinel}

When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points and not killed outright, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead, and you regain a number of Hit Points equal to three times your Paladin level. Once you use this feature, you can’t do so again until you finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest").

Additionally, you can’t be aged magically, and you cease visibly aging.

##### Level 20: Elder Champion {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level20ElderChampion}

As a Bonus Action, you can imbue your Aura of Protection with primal power, granting the benefits below for 1 minute or until you end them (no action required). Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest"). You can also restore your use of it by expending a level 5 spell slot (no action required).

**_Diminish Defiance._** Enemies in the aura have [**Disadvantage**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:disadvantage "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#disadvantage") on saving throws against your spells and Channel Divinity options.

**_Regeneration._** At the start of each of your turns, you regain 10 Hit Points.

**_Swift Spells._** Whenever you cast a spell that has a casting time of an action, you can cast it using a Bonus Action instead.

#### Oath of Vengeance {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:OathofVengeance}

_Punish Evildoers at Any Cost_

The Oath of Vengeance is a solemn commitment to punish those who have committed grievously evil acts. When evil armies slaughter helpless villagers, when a tyrant defies the will of the gods, when a thieves’ guild grows too violent, when a dragon rampages through the countryside—at times like these, paladins arise and swear an Oath of Vengeance to set right what has gone wrong.

[![Oath of Vengeance Subclass (Artist: IGNATIUS BUDI)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-006.oath-of-vengeance.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-006.oath-of-vengeance.png)

These paladins share the following tenets:

- Show the wicked no mercy.
- Fight injustice and its causes.
- Aid those harmed by injustice.

##### Level 3: Oath of Vengeance Spells {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level3OathofVengeanceSpells}

The magic of your oath ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Paladin level specified in the Oath of Vengeance Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

**Oath of Vengeance Spells**

| Paladin Level | Spells                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 3             | [**Bane**](#ref:spell:2618900-bane "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618900-bane"), [**Hunter’s Mark**](#ref:spell:2619166-hunters-mark "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619166-hunters-mark")                                 |
| 5             | [**Hold Person**](#ref:spell:2619153-hold-person "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619153-hold-person"), [**Misty Step**](#ref:spell:2619133-misty-step "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619133-misty-step")                   |
| 9             | [**Haste**](#ref:spell:2619141-haste "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619141-haste"), [**Protection from Energy**](#ref:spell:2618908-protection-from-energy "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618908-protection-from-energy") |
| 13            | [**Banishment**](#ref:spell:2618906-banishment "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618906-banishment"), [**Dimension Door**](#ref:spell:2619100-dimension-door "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619100-dimension-door")          |
| 17            | [**Hold Monster**](#ref:spell:2619152-hold-monster "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619152-hold-monster"), [**Scrying**](#ref:spell:2619007-scrying "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619007-scrying")                         |

##### Level 3: Vow of Enmity {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level3VowofEnmity}

When you take the [**Attack**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:attackaction "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#attackaction") action, you can expend one use of your Channel Divinity to utter a vow of enmity against a creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself. You have [**Advantage**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:advantage "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#advantage") on attack rolls against the creature for 1 minute or until you use this feature again.

If the creature drops to 0 Hit Points before the vow ends, you can transfer the vow to a different creature within 30 feet of yourself (no action required).

##### Level 7: Relentless Avenger {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level7RelentlessAvenger}

Your supernatural focus helps you close off a foe’s retreat. When you hit a creature with an [**Opportunity Attack**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:opportunityattack "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#opportunityattack"), you can reduce the creature’s Speed to 0 until the end of the current turn. You can then move up to half your Speed as part of the same Reaction. This movement doesn’t provoke Opportunity Attacks.

##### Level 15: Soul of Vengeance {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level15SoulofVengeance}

Immediately after a creature under the effect of your Vow of Enmity hits or misses with an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to make a melee attack against that creature if it’s within range.

##### Level 20: Avenging Angel {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level20AvengingAngel}

As a Bonus Action, you gain the benefits below for 10 minutes or until you end them (no action required). Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest"). You can also restore your use of it by expending a level 5 spell slot (no action required).

**_Flight._** You sprout spectral wings on your back, have a Fly Speed of 60 feet, and can hover.

**_Frightful Aura._** Whenever an enemy starts its turn in your Aura of Protection, that creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the [**Frightened**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:frightenedcondition "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#frightenedcondition") condition for 1 minute or until it takes any damage. Attack rolls against the Frightened creature have [**Advantage**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:advantage "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#advantage").

## Ranger {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Ranger}

[![A Wandering Warrior Imbued with Primal Magic (Artist: CHRIS RALLIS)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-007.ranger.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-007.ranger.png)

**Core Ranger Traits**

| Primary Ability            | Dexterity and Wisdom                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Hit Point Die              | D10 per Ranger level                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Saving Throw Proficiencies | Strength and Dexterity                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Skill Proficiencies        | _Choose 3:_ [**Animal Handling**](#phb-2024:playing-the-game:skills "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/playing-the-game#skills"), [**Athletics**](#phb-2024:playing-the-game:skills "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/playing-the-game#skills"), [**Insight**](#phb-2024:playing-the-game:skills "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/playing-the-game#skills"), [**Investigation**](#phb-2024:playing-the-game:skills "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/playing-the-game#skills"), [**Nature**](#phb-2024:playing-the-game:skills "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/playing-the-game#skills"), [**Perception**](#phb-2024:playing-the-game:skills "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/playing-the-game#skills"), [**Stealth**](#phb-2024:playing-the-game:skills "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/playing-the-game#skills"), or [**Survival**](#phb-2024:playing-the-game:skills "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/playing-the-game#skills")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Weapon Proficiencies       | Simple and Martial weapons                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Armor Training             | Light and Medium armor and Shields                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Starting Equipment         | _Choose A or B:_ (A) [**Studded Leather Armor**](#ref:equipment:3-studded-leather "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/3-studded-leather"), [**Scimitar**](#ref:equipment:29-scimitar "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/29-scimitar"), [**Shortsword**](#ref:equipment:30-shortsword "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/30-shortsword"), [**Longbow**](#ref:equipment:37-longbow "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/37-longbow"), 20 [**Arrows**](#ref:equipment:508-arrows "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/508-arrows"), [**Quiver**](#ref:equipment:407-quiver "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/407-quiver"), [**Druidic Focus**](#ref:equipment:532-druidic-focus "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/532-druidic-focus") ([**sprig of mistletoe**](#ref:equipment:531-sprig-of-mistletoe "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/531-sprig-of-mistletoe")), [**Explorer’s Pack**](#ref:equipment:522-explorers-pack "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/522-explorers-pack"), and 7 GP; or (B) 150 GP |

Far from bustling cities, amid the trees of trackless forests and across wide plains, Rangers keep their unending watch in the wilderness. Rangers learn to track their quarry as a predator does, moving stealthily through the wilds and hiding themselves in brush and rubble.

Thanks to their connection with nature, Rangers can also cast spells that harness primal powers of the wilderness. A Ranger’s talents and magic are honed with deadly focus to protect the world from the ravages of monsters and tyrants.

#### Becoming a Ranger... {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:BecomingaRanger}

##### As a Level 1 Character {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:AsaLevel1Character}

- Gain all the traits in the [Core Ranger Traits table](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:corerangertraits "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#corerangertraits").
- Gain the Ranger’s level 1 features, which are listed in the [Ranger Features table](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:rangerfeatures "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#rangerfeatures").

##### As a Multiclass Character {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:AsaMulticlassCharacter}

- Gain the following traits from the [Core Ranger Traits table](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:corerangertraits "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#corerangertraits"): Hit Point Die, proficiency with Martial weapons, proficiency in one skill of your choice from the Ranger’s skill list, and training with Light and Medium armor and Shields.
- Gain the Ranger’s level 1 features, which are listed in the [Ranger Features table](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:rangerfeatures "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#rangerfeatures"). See the multiclassing rules in [chapter 2](#phb-2024:creating-a-character:Multiclassing "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/creating-a-character#Multiclassing") to determine your available spell slots.

#### Level 1: Spellcasting {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level1Spellcasting}

You have learned to channel the magical essence of nature to cast spells. See [chapter 7](#phb-2024:spells "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/spells") for the rules on spellcasting. The information below details how you use those rules with Ranger spells, which appear in the [Ranger spell list](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:rangerspelllist "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#rangerspelllist") later in the class’s description.

**_Spell Slots._** The [Ranger Features table](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:rangerfeatures "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#rangerfeatures") shows how many spell slots you have to cast your level 1+ spells. You regain all expended slots when you finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest").

**_Prepared Spells of Level 1+_**. You prepare the list of level 1+ spells that are available for you to cast with this feature. To start, choose two level 1 Ranger spells. [**Cure Wounds**](#ref:spell:2619079-cure-wounds "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619079-cure-wounds") and [**Ensnaring Strike**](#ref:spell:2619172-ensnaring-strike "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619172-ensnaring-strike") are recommended.

The number of spells on your list increases as you gain Ranger levels, as shown in the Prepared Spells column of the [Ranger Features table](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:rangerfeatures "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#rangerfeatures"). Whenever that number increases, choose additional Ranger spells until the number of spells on your list matches the number in the Ranger Features table. The chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. For example, if you’re a level 5 Ranger, your list of prepared spells can include six Ranger spells of level 1 or 2 in any combination.

If another Ranger feature gives you spells that you always have prepared, those spells don’t count against the number of spells you can prepare with this feature, but those spells otherwise count as Ranger spells for you.

**_Changing Your Prepared Spells._** Whenever you finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest"), you can replace one spell on your list with another Ranger spell for which you have spell slots.

**_Spellcasting Ability._** Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for your Ranger spells.

**_Spellcasting Focus._** You can use a [**Druidic Focus**](#ref:equipment:532-druidic-focus "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/532-druidic-focus") as a Spellcasting Focus for your Ranger spells.

#### Level 1: Favored Enemy {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level1FavoredEnemy}

You always have the [**Hunter’s Mark**](#ref:spell:2619166-hunters-mark "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619166-hunters-mark") spell prepared. You can cast it twice without expending a spell slot, and you regain all expended uses of this ability when you finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest").

The number of times you can cast the spell without a spell slot increases when you reach certain Ranger levels, as shown in the Favored Enemy column of the [Ranger Features table](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:rangerfeatures "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#rangerfeatures").

#### Level 1: Weapon Mastery {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level1WeaponMastery}

Your training with weapons allows you to use the [mastery properties](#phb-2024:equipment:masteryproperties "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/equipment#masteryproperties") of two kinds of weapons of your choice with which you have proficiency, such as Longbows and Shortswords.

Whenever you finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest"), you can change the kinds of weapons you chose. For example, you could switch to using the mastery properties of Scimitars and Longswords.

#### Level 2: Deft Explorer {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level2DeftExplorer}

Thanks to your travels, you gain the following benefits.

**_Expertise._** Choose one of your skill proficiencies with which you lack [**Expertise**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:expertise "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#expertise"). You gain Expertise in that skill.

**_Languages._** You know two languages of your choice from the language tables in [chapter 2](#phb-2024:creating-a-character:chooselanguages "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/creating-a-character#chooselanguages").

#### Level 2: Fighting Style {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level2FightingStyle}

You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice (see [chapter 5](#phb-2024:feats:FightingStyleFeats "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/feats#FightingStyleFeats")). Instead of choosing one of those feats, you can choose the option below.

**_Druidic Warrior._** You learn two Druid cantrips of your choice (see the Druid class’s section for a [list of Druid spells](#phb-2024:character-classes:druidspelllist "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes#druidspelllist")). [**Guidance**](#ref:spell:2618971-guidance "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618971-guidance") and [**Starry Wisp**](#ref:spell:2618840-starry-wisp "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618840-starry-wisp") are recommended. The chosen cantrips count as Ranger spells for you, and Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for them. Whenever you gain a Ranger level, you can replace one of these cantrips with another Druid cantrip.

#### Level 3: Ranger Subclass {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level3RangerSubclass}

You gain a Ranger subclass of your choice.The [Beast Master](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:beastmaster "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#beastmaster"), [Fey Wanderer](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:feywanderer "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#feywanderer"), [Gloom Stalker](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:gloomstalker "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#gloomstalker"), and [Hunter](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:hunter "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#hunter") subclasses are detailed after this class’s description. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Ranger levels. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass’s features that are of your Ranger level or lower.

#### Level 4: Ability Score Improvement {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level4AbilityScoreImprovement}

You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat (see [chapter 5](#phb-2024:feats:abilityscoreimprovement "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/feats#abilityscoreimprovement")) or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at Ranger levels 8, 12, and 16.

#### Level 5: Extra Attack {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level5ExtraAttack}

You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the [**Attack**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:attackaction "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#attackaction") action on your turn.

[![(Artist: MIKE PAPE)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-008.ranger-and-deer.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-008.ranger-and-deer.png)

#### Level 6: Roving {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level6Roving}

Your Speed increases by 10 feet while you aren’t wearing Heavy armor. You also have a Climb Speed and a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

#### Level 9: Expertise {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level9Expertise}

Choose two of your skill proficiencies with which you lack [**Expertise**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:expertise "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#expertise"). You gain Expertise in those skills.

#### Level 10: Tireless {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level10Tireless}

Primal forces now help fuel you on your journeys, granting you the following benefits.

**_Temporary Hit Points._** As a [**Magic**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:magicaction "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#magicaction") action, you can give yourself a number of [**Temporary Hit Points**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:temporaryhitpoints "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#temporaryhitpoints") equal to 1d8 plus your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1). You can use this action a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest").

**_Decrease Exhaustion._** Whenever you finish a [**Short Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:shortrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#shortrest"), your [**Exhaustion**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:exhaustioncondition "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#exhaustioncondition") level, if any, decreases by 1.

#### Level 13: Relentless Hunter {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level13RelentlessHunter}

Taking damage can’t break your [**Concentration**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:concentration "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#concentration") on [**Hunter’s Mark**](#ref:spell:2619166-hunters-mark "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619166-hunters-mark").

#### Level 14: Nature’s Veil {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level14NaturesVeil}

You invoke spirits of nature to magically hide yourself. As a Bonus Action, you can give yourself the [**Invisible**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:invisiblecondition "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#invisiblecondition") condition until the end of your next turn.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest").

#### Level 17: Precise Hunter {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level17PreciseHunter}

You have [**Advantage**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:advantage "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#advantage") on attack rolls against the creature currently marked by your [**Hunter’s Mark**](#ref:spell:2619166-hunters-mark "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619166-hunters-mark").

#### Level 18: Feral Senses {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level18FeralSenses}

Your connection to the forces of nature grants you [**Blindsight**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:blindsight "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#blindsight") with a range of 30 feet.

#### Level 19: Epic Boon {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level19EpicBoon}

You gain an Epic Boon feat (see [chapter 5](#phb-2024:feats:EpicBoonFeats "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/feats#EpicBoonFeats")) or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. [Boon of Dimensional Travel](#phb-2024:feats:boonofdimensionaltravel "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/feats#boonofdimensionaltravel") is recommended.

#### Level 20: Foe Slayer {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level20FoeSlayer}

The damage die of your [**Hunter’s Mark**](#ref:spell:2619166-hunters-mark "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619166-hunters-mark") is a d10 rather than a d6.

### Ranger Subclasses {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:RangerSubclasses}

A Ranger subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Ranger levels, as specified in the subclass. This section presents the [Beast Master](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:beastmaster "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#beastmaster"), [Fey Wanderer](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:feywanderer "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#feywanderer"), [Gloom Stalker](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:gloomstalker "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#gloomstalker"), and [Hunter](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:hunter "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#hunter") subclasses.

#### Beast Master {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:BeastMaster}

_Bond with a Primal Beast_

A Beast Master forms a mystical bond with a special animal, drawing on primal magic and a deep connection to the natural world.

[![Beast Master Subclass (Artist: ALDITHA SIREGAR)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-009.beast-master.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-009.beast-master.png)

##### Level 3: Primal Companion {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level3PrimalCompanion}

You magically summon a primal beast, which draws strength from your bond with nature. Choose its stat block: **[Beast of the Land](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:beastoftheland "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#beastoftheland")**, **[Beast of the Sea](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:beastofthesea "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#beastofthesea")**, or **[Beast of the Sky](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:beastofthesky "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#beastofthesky")**. You also determine the kind of animal it is, choosing a kind appropriate for the stat block. Whatever beast you choose, it bears primal markings indicating its supernatural origin.

The beast is [**Friendly**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:friendlyattitude "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#friendlyattitude") to you and your allies and obeys your commands. It vanishes if you die.

**_The Beast in Combat._** In combat, the beast acts during your turn. It can move and use its Reaction on its own, but the only action it takes is the [**Dodge**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:dodgeaction "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#dodgeaction") action unless you take a Bonus Action to command it to take an action in its stat block or some other action. You can also sacrifice one of your attacks when you take the [**Attack**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:attackaction "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#attackaction") action to command the beast to take the Beast’s Strike action. If you have the [**Incapacitated**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:incapacitatedcondition "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#incapacitatedcondition") condition, the beast acts on its own and isn’t limited to the Dodge action.

**_Restoring or Replacing the Beast._** If the beast has died within the last hour, you can take a [**Magic**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:magicaction "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#magicaction") action to touch it and expend a spell slot. The beast returns to life after 1 minute with all its Hit Points restored.

Whenever you finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest"), you can summon a different primal beast, which appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you. You choose its stat block and appearance. If you already have a beast from this feature, the old one vanishes when the new one appears.

##### Beast of the Land {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:BeastoftheLand}

Medium Beast, Neutral

**AC** 13 plus your Wisdom modifier

**HP** 5 plus five times your Ranger level (the beast has a number of Hit Dice [d8s] equal to your Ranger level)

**Speed** 40 ft., Climb 40 ft.

**STR** 14 (+2) | **DEX** 14 (+2) | **CON** 15 (+2) | **INT** 8 (−1) | **WIS** 14 (+2) | **CHA** 11 (+0)

**Senses** [**Darkvision**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:darkvision "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#darkvision") 60 ft.; Passive Perception 12

**Languages** Understands the languages you know

**CR** None (XP 0; PB equals your Proficiency Bonus)

#### Traits {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Traits}

**_Primal Bond._** Add your Proficiency Bonus to any ability check or saving throw the beast makes.

#### Actions {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Actions}

**_Beast’s Strike._** _Melee Attack Roll:_ Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 1d8 + 2 plus your Wisdom modifier Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage (your choice when you summon the beast). If the beast moved at least 20 feet straight toward the target before the hit, the target takes an extra 1d6 damage of the same type, and the target has the [**Prone**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:pronecondition "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#pronecondition") condition if it is a Large or smaller creature.

##### Beast of the Sea {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:BeastoftheSea}

Medium Beast, Neutral

**AC** 13 plus your Wisdom modifier

**HP** 5 plus five times your Ranger level (the beast has a number of Hit Dice [d8s] equal to your Ranger level)

**Speed** 5 ft., Swim 60 ft.

**STR** 14 (+2) | **DEX** 14 (+2) | **CON** 15 (+2) | **INT** 8 (−1) | **WIS** 14 (+2) | **CHA** 11 (+0)

**Senses** [**Darkvision**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:darkvision "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#darkvision") 90 ft.; Passive Perception 12

**Languages** Understands the languages you know

**CR** None (XP 0; PB equals your Proficiency Bonus)

#### Traits {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Traits}

**_Amphibious._** The beast can breathe air and water.

**_Primal Bond._** Add your Proficiency Bonus to any ability check or saving throw the beast makes.

#### Actions {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Actions}

**_Beast’s Strike._** _Melee Attack Roll:_ Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 1d6 + 2 plus your Wisdom modifier Bludgeoning or Piercing damage (your choice when you summon the beast), and the target has the [**Grappled**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:grappledcondition "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#grappledcondition") condition (escape DC equals your spell save DC).

##### Beast of the Sky {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:BeastoftheSky}

Small Beast, Neutral

**AC** 13 plus your Wisdom modifier

**HP** 4 plus four times your Ranger level (the beast has a number of Hit Dice [d6s] equal to your Ranger level)

**Speed** 10 ft., Fly 60 ft.

**STR** 6 (−2) | **DEX** 16 (+3) | **CON** 13 (+1) | **INT** 8 (−1) | **WIS** 14 (+2) | **CHA** 11 (+0)

**Senses** [**Darkvision**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:darkvision "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#darkvision") 60 ft.; Passive Perception 12

**Languages** Understands the languages you know

**CR** None (XP 0; PB equals your Proficiency Bonus)

#### Traits {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Traits}

**_Flyby._** The beast doesn’t provoke [**Opportunity Attacks**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:opportunityattack "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#opportunityattack") when it flies out of an enemy’s reach.

**_Primal Bond._** Add your Proficiency Bonus to any ability check or saving throw the beast makes.

#### Actions {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Actions}

**_Beast’s Strike._** _Melee Attack Roll:_ Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 1d4 + 3 plus your Wisdom modifier Slashing damage.

##### Level 7: Exceptional Training {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level7ExceptionalTraining}

When you take a Bonus Action to command your Primal Companion beast to take an action, you can also command it to take the [**Dash**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:dashaction "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#dashaction"), [**Disengage**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:disengageaction "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#disengageaction"), [**Dodge**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:dodgeaction "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#dodgeaction"), or [**Help**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:helpaction "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#helpaction") action using its Bonus Action.

In addition, whenever it hits with an attack roll and deals damage, it can deal your choice of Force damage or its normal damage type.

##### Level 11: Bestial Fury {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level11BestialFury}

When you command your Primal Companion beast to take the Beast’s Strike action, the beast can use it twice.

In addition, the first time each turn it hits a creature under the effect of your [**Hunter’s Mark**](#ref:spell:2619166-hunters-mark "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619166-hunters-mark") spell, the beast deals extra Force damage equal to the bonus damage of that spell.

##### Level 15: Share Spells {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level15ShareSpells}

When you cast a spell targeting yourself, you can also affect your Primal Companion beast with the spell if the beast is within 30 feet of you.

#### Fey Wanderer {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:FeyWanderer}

_Wield Fey Mirth and Fury_

A fey mystique surrounds you, thanks to the boon of an archfey or a location in the Feywild that transformed you. However you gained fey magic, you are now a Fey Wanderer. Your joyful laughter brightens the hearts of the downtrodden, and your martial prowess strikes terror in your foes, for great is the mirth of the fey and dreadful is their fury.

##### Level 3: Dreadful Strikes {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level3DreadfulStrikes}

You can augment your weapon strikes with mind-scarring magic drawn from the murky hollows of the Feywild. When you hit a creature with a weapon, you can deal an extra 1d4 Psychic damage to the target, which can take this extra damage only once per turn. The extra damage increases to 1d6 when you reach Ranger level 11.

##### Level 3: Fey Wanderer Spells {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level3FeyWandererSpells}

When you reach a Ranger level specified in the Fey Wanderer Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

**Fey Wanderer Spells**

| Ranger Level | Spell                                                                                                             |
| ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 3            | [**Charm Person**](#ref:spell:2618964-charm-person "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618964-charm-person")       |
| 5            | [**Misty Step**](#ref:spell:2619133-misty-step "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619133-misty-step")             |
| 9            | [**Summon Fey**](#ref:spell:2619115-summon-fey "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619115-summon-fey")             |
| 13           | [**Dimension Door**](#ref:spell:2619100-dimension-door "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619100-dimension-door") |
| 17           | [**Mislead**](#ref:spell:2619131-mislead "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619131-mislead")                      |

You also possess a fey blessing. Choose it from the Feywild Gifts table or determine it randomly.

[![Fey Wanderer Subclass (Artist: JOHN GRELLO)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-010.fey-wanderer.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-010.fey-wanderer.png)

**Feywild Gifts**

| 1d6 | Gift                                                                                  |
| --- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 1   | Illusory butterflies flutter around you while you take a Short or Long Rest.          |
| 2   | Flowers bloom from your hair each dawn.                                               |
| 3   | You faintly smell of cinnamon, lavender, nutmeg, or another comforting herb or spice. |
| 4   | Your shadow dances while no one is looking directly at it.                            |
| 5   | Horns or antlers sprout from your head.                                               |
| 6   | Your skin and hair change color each dawn.                                            |

##### Level 3: Otherworldly Glamour {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level3OtherworldlyGlamour}

Whenever you make a Charisma check, you gain a bonus to the check equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of +1).

You also gain proficiency in one of these skills of your choice: [**Deception**](#phb-2024:playing-the-game:skills "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/playing-the-game#skills"), [**Performance**](#phb-2024:playing-the-game:skills "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/playing-the-game#skills"), or [**Persuasion**](#phb-2024:playing-the-game:skills "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/playing-the-game#skills").

##### Level 7: Beguiling Twist {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level7BeguilingTwist}

The magic of the Feywild guards your mind. You have [**Advantage**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:advantage "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#advantage") on saving throws to avoid or end the [**Charmed**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:charmedcondition "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#charmedcondition") or [**Frightened**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:frightenedcondition "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#frightenedcondition") condition.

In addition, whenever you or a creature you can see within 120 feet of you succeeds on a saving throw to avoid or end the Charmed or Frightened condition, you can take a Reaction to force a different creature you can see within 120 feet of yourself to make a Wisdom save against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the target is Charmed or Frightened (your choice) for 1 minute. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

##### Level 11: Fey Reinforcements {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level11FeyReinforcements}

You can cast [**Summon Fey**](#ref:spell:2619115-summon-fey "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619115-summon-fey") without a Material component. You can also cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest").

Whenever you start casting the spell, you can modify it so that it doesn’t require [**Concentration**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:concentration "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#concentration"). If you do so, the spell’s duration becomes 1 minute for that casting.

##### Level 15: Misty Wanderer {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level15MistyWanderer}

You can cast [**Misty Step**](#ref:spell:2619133-misty-step "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619133-misty-step") without expending a spell slot. You can do so a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest").

In addition, whenever you cast _Misty Step_, you can bring along one willing creature you can see within 5 feet of yourself. That creature teleports to an unoccupied space of your choice within 5 feet of your destination space.

#### Gloom Stalker {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:GloomStalker}

_Draw on Shadow Magic to Fight Your Foes_

Gloom Stalkers are at home in the darkest places, wielding magic drawn from the Shadowfell to combat enemies that lurk in darkness.

[![Gloom Stalker Subclass (Artist: POLAR ENGINE)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-011.gloom-stalker.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-011.gloom-stalker.png)

##### Level 3: Dread Ambusher {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level3DreadAmbusher}

You have mastered the art of creating fearsome ambushes, granting you the following benefits.

**_Ambusher’s Leap._** At the start of your first turn of each combat, your Speed increases by 10 feet until the end of that turn.

**_Dreadful Strike._** When you attack a creature and hit it with a weapon, you can deal an extra 2d6 Psychic damage. You can use this benefit only once per turn, you can use it a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest").

**_Initiative Bonus._** When you roll [**Initiative**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:initiative "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#initiative"), you can add your Wisdom modifier to the roll.

##### Level 3: Gloom Stalker Spells {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level3GloomStalkerSpells}

When you reach a Ranger level specified in the Gloom Stalker Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

**Gloom Stalker Spells**

| Ranger Level | Spells                                                                                                                              |
| ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 3            | [**Disguise Self**](#ref:spell:2619102-disguise-self "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619102-disguise-self")                      |
| 5            | [**Rope Trick**](#ref:spell:2618962-rope-trick "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618962-rope-trick")                               |
| 9            | [**Fear**](#ref:spell:2618872-fear "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618872-fear")                                                 |
| 13           | [**Greater Invisibility**](#ref:spell:2618958-greater-invisibility "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618958-greater-invisibility") |
| 17           | [**Seeming**](#ref:spell:2619014-seeming "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619014-seeming")                                        |

##### Level 3: Umbral Sight {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level3UmbralSight}

You gain [**Darkvision**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:darkvision "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#darkvision") with a range of 60 feet. If you already have Darkvision when you gain this feature, its range increases by 60 feet.

You are also adept at evading creatures that rely on Darkvision. While entirely in [**Darkness**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:darkness "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#darkness"), you have the [**Invisible**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:invisiblecondition "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#invisiblecondition") condition to any creature that relies on Darkvision to see you in that Darkness.

##### Level 7: Iron Mind {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level7IronMind}

You have honed your ability to resist mind-altering powers. You gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws. If you already have this proficiency, you instead gain proficiency in Intelligence or Charisma saving throws (your choice).

##### Level 11: Stalker’s Flurry {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level11StalkersFlurry}

The Psychic damage of your Dreadful Strike becomes 2d8. In addition, when you use the Dreadful Strike effect of your Dread Ambusher feature, you can cause one of the following additional effects.

**_Sudden Strike._** You can make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature that is within 5 feet of the original target and that is within the weapon’s range.

**_Mass Fear._** The target and each creature within 10 feet of it must make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, a creature has the [**Frightened**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:frightenedcondition "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#frightenedcondition") condition until the start of your next turn.

##### Level 15: Shadowy Dodge {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level15ShadowyDodge}

When a creature makes an attack roll against you, you can take a Reaction to impose [**Disadvantage**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:disadvantage "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#disadvantage") on that roll. Whether the attack hits or misses, you can then teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

#### Hunter {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Hunter}

[![Hunter Subclass (Artist: KATERINA LADON)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-012.hunter.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-012.hunter.png)

_Protect Nature and People from Destruction_

You stalk prey in the wilds and elsewhere, using your abilities as a Hunter to protect nature and people everywhere from forces that would destroy them.

##### Level 3: Hunter’s Lore {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level3HuntersLore}

You can call on the forces of nature to reveal certain strengths and weaknesses of your prey. While a creature is marked by your [**Hunter’s Mark**](#ref:spell:2619166-hunters-mark "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619166-hunters-mark"), you know whether that creature has any Immunities, Resistances, or Vulnerabilities, and if the creature has any, you know what they are.

##### Level 3: Hunter’s Prey {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level3HuntersPrey}

You gain one of the following feature options of your choice. Whenever you finish a [**Short**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:shortrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#shortrest") or [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest"), you can replace the chosen option with the other one.

**_Colossus Slayer._** Your tenacity can wear down even the most resilient foes. When you hit a creature with a weapon, the weapon deals an extra 1d8 damage to the target if it’s missing any of its Hit Points. You can deal this extra damage only once per turn.

**_Horde Breaker._** Once on each of your turns when you make an attack with a weapon, you can make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature that is within 5 feet of the original target, that is within the weapon’s range, and that you haven’t attacked this turn.

##### Level 7: Defensive Tactics {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level7DefensiveTactics}

You gain one of the following feature options of your choice. Whenever you finish a [**Short**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:shortrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#shortrest") or [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest"), you can replace the chosen option with the other one.

**_Escape the Horde._** [**Opportunity Attacks**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:opportunityattack "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#opportunityattack") have [**Disadvantage**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:disadvantage "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#disadvantage") against you.

**_Multiattack Defense._** When a creature hits you with an attack roll, that creature has [**Disadvantage**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:disadvantage "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#disadvantage") on all other attack rolls against you this turn.

##### Level 11: Superior Hunter’s Prey {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level11SuperiorHuntersPrey}

Once per turn when you deal damage to a creature marked by your [**Hunter’s Mark**](#ref:spell:2619166-hunters-mark "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619166-hunters-mark"), you can also deal that spell’s extra damage to a different creature that you can see within 30 feet of the first creature.

##### Level 15: Superior Hunter’s Defense {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level15SuperiorHuntersDefense}

When you take damage, you can take a Reaction to give yourself Resistance to that damage and any other damage of the same type until the end of the current turn.

## Rogue {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Rogue}

[![A Dexterous Expert in Stealth and Subterfuge (Artist: AURORE FOLNY)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-013.rogue.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-013.rogue.png)

**Core Rogue Traits**

| -------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

| Saving Throw Proficiencies | Dexterity and Intelligence                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |

| Tool Proficiencies         | Thieves’ Tools                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Armor Training             | Light armor                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Starting Equipment         | _Choose A or B:_ (A) [**Leather Armor**](#ref:equipment:10-leather "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/10-leather"), 2 [**Daggers**](#ref:equipment:3-dagger "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/3-dagger"), [**Shortsword**](#ref:equipment:30-shortsword "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/30-shortsword"), [**Shortbow**](#ref:equipment:17-shortbow "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/17-shortbow"), 20 [**Arrows**](#ref:equipment:508-arrows "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/508-arrows"), [**Quiver**](#ref:equipment:407-quiver "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/407-quiver"), [**Thieves’ Tools**](#ref:equipment:495-thieves-tools "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/495-thieves-tools"), [**Burglar’s Pack**](#ref:equipment:491-burglars-pack "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/491-burglars-pack"), and 8 GP; or (B) 100 GP                                                                                                         |

Rogues rely on cunning, stealth, and their foes’ vulnerabilities to get the upper hand in any situation. They have a knack for finding the solution to just about any problem. A few even learn magical tricks to supplement their other abilities. Many Rogues focus on stealth and deception, while others refine skills that help them in a dungeon environment, such as climbing, finding and disarming traps, and opening locks.

In combat, Rogues prioritize subtle strikes over brute strength. They would rather make one precise strike than wear an opponent down with a barrage of blows.

Some Rogues began their careers as criminals, while others used their cunning to fight crime. Whatever a Rogue’s relation to the law, no common criminal or officer of the law can match the subtle brilliance of the greatest Rogues.

#### Becoming a Rogue... {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:BecomingaRogue}

##### As a Level 1 Character {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:AsaLevel1Character}

- Gain all the traits in the [Core Rogue Traits table](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:coreroguetraits "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#coreroguetraits").
- Gain the Rogue’s level 1 features, which are listed in the [Rogue Features table](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:roguefeatures "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#roguefeatures").

##### As a Multiclass Character {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:AsaMulticlassCharacter}

- Gain the following traits from the [Core Rogue Traits table](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:coreroguetraits "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#coreroguetraits"): Hit Point Die, proficiency in one skill of your choice from the Rogue’s skill list, proficiency with Thieves’ Tools, and training with Light armor.
- Gain the Rogue’s level 1 features, which are listed in the [Rogue Features table](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:roguefeatures "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#roguefeatures").

As a Rogue, you gain the following class features when you reach the specified Rogue levels. These features are listed in the Rogue Features table.
