| --- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| 1   | Spectral cogwheels hover behind you.                                                             |
| 2   | The hands of a clock spin in your eyes.                                                          |
| 3   | Your skin glows with a brassy sheen.                                                             |
| 4   | Floating equations and geometric objects overlay your body.                                      |
| 5   | Your Spellcasting Focus temporarily takes the form of a Tiny clockwork mechanism.                |
| 6   | The ticking of gears or ringing of a clock can be heard by you and those affected by your magic. |

##### Level 3: Restore Balance {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level3RestoreBalance}

Your connection to the plane of absolute order allows you to equalize chaotic moments. When a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself is about to roll a d20 with [**Advantage**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:advantage "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#advantage") or [**Disadvantage**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:disadvantage "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#disadvantage"), you can take a Reaction to prevent the roll from being affected by Advantage and Disadvantage.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest").

##### Level 6: Bastion of Law {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level6BastionofLaw}

You can tap into the grand equation of existence to imbue a creature with a shimmering shield of order. As a [**Magic**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:magicaction "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#magicaction") action, you can expend 1 to 5 Sorcery Points to create a magical ward around yourself or another creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself. The ward is represented by a number of d8s equal to the number of Sorcery Points spent to create it. When the warded creature takes damage, it can expend a number of those dice, roll them, and reduce the damage taken by the total rolled on those dice.

The ward lasts until you finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest") or until you use this feature again.

##### Level 14: Trance of Order {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level14TranceofOrder}

You gain the ability to align your consciousness with the endless calculations of Mechanus. As a Bonus Action, you can enter this state for 1 minute. For the duration, attack rolls against you can’t benefit from [**Advantage**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:advantage "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#advantage"), and whenever you make a [**D20 Test**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:d20test "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#d20test"), you can treat a roll of 9 or lower on the d20 as a 10.

Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest") unless you spend 5 Sorcery Points (no action required) to restore your use of it.

##### Level 18: Clockwork Cavalcade {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level18ClockworkCavalcade}

You momentarily summon spirits of order to expunge disorder around you. As a [**Magic**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:magicaction "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#magicaction") action, you summon the spirits in a 30-foot [**Cube**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:cubeareaofeffect "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#cubeareaofeffect") originating from you. The spirits look like modrons or other Constructs of your choice. The spirits are intangible and invulnerable, and they create the effects below within the Cube before vanishing. Once you use this action, you can’t use it again until you finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest") unless you spend 7 Sorcery Points (no action required) to restore your use of it.

**_Heal._** The spirits restore up to 100 Hit Points, divided as you choose among any number of creatures of your choice in the Cube.

**_Repair._** Any damaged objects entirely in the Cube are repaired instantly.

**_Dispel._** Every spell of level 6 and lower ends on creatures and objects of your choice in the Cube.

#### Draconic Sorcery {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:DraconicSorcery}

_Breathe the Magic of Dragons_

Your innate magic comes from the gift of a dragon. Perhaps an ancient dragon facing death bequeathed some of its magical power to you or your ancestor. You might have absorbed magic from a site infused with dragons’ power. Or perhaps you handled a treasure taken from a dragon’s hoard that was steeped in draconic power. Or you might have a dragon for an ancestor.

[![Draconic Sorcery Subclass (Artist: LAUREN WALSH)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-025.draconic.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-025.draconic.png)

##### Level 3: Draconic Resilience {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level3DraconicResilience}

The magic in your body manifests physical traits of your draconic gift. Your Hit Point maximum increases by 3, and it increases by 1 whenever you gain another Sorcerer level.

Parts of you are also covered by dragon-like scales. While you aren’t wearing armor, your base Armor Class equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Charisma modifiers.

##### Level 3: Draconic Spells {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level3DraconicSpells}

When you reach a Sorcerer level specified in the Draconic Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

**Draconic Spells**

| Sorcerer Level | Spells                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| -------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 3              | [**Alter Self**](#ref:spell:2618846-alter-self "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618846-alter-self"), [**Chromatic Orb**](#ref:spell:2618966-chromatic-orb "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618966-chromatic-orb"), [**Command**](#ref:spell:2618985-command "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618985-command"), [**Dragon’s Breath**](#ref:spell:2619150-dragons-breath "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619150-dragons-breath") |
| 5              | [**Fear**](#ref:spell:2618872-fear "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618872-fear"), [**Fly**](#ref:spell:2618909-fly "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618909-fly")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| 7              | [**Arcane Eye**](#ref:spell:2618863-arcane-eye "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618863-arcane-eye"), [**Charm Monster**](#ref:spell:2618963-charm-monster "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618963-charm-monster")                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| 9              | [**Legend Lore**](#ref:spell:2619010-legend-lore "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619010-legend-lore"), [**Summon Dragon**](#ref:spell:2618843-summon-dragon "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618843-summon-dragon")                                                                                                                                                                                                                |

##### Level 6: Elemental Affinity {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level6ElementalAffinity}

Your draconic magic has an affinity with a damage type associated with dragons. Choose one of those types: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison.

You have Resistance to that damage type, and when you cast a spell that deals damage of that type, you can add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of that spell.

##### Level 14: Dragon Wings {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level14DragonWings}

As a Bonus Action, you can cause draconic wings to appear on your back. The wings last for 1 hour or until you dismiss them (no action required). For the duration, you have a Fly Speed of 60 feet.

Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest") unless you spend 3 Sorcery Points (no action required) to restore your use of it.

##### Level 18: Dragon Companion {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level18DragonCompanion}

You can cast [**Summon Dragon**](#ref:spell:2618843-summon-dragon "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618843-summon-dragon") without a Material component. You can also cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest").

Whenever you start casting the spell, you can modify it so that it doesn’t require [**Concentration**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:concentration "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#concentration"). If you do so, the spell’s duration becomes 1 minute for that casting.

#### Wild Magic Sorcery {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:WildMagicSorcery}

_Unleash Chaotic Magic_

Your innate magic stems from the forces of chaos that underlie the order of creation. You or an ancestor might have endured exposure to raw magic, perhaps through a planar portal leading to Limbo or the Elemental Planes. Perhaps you were blessed by a fey being or marked by a demon. Or your magic could be a fluke with no apparent cause. Whatever its source, this magic churns within you, waiting for any outlet.

##### Level 3: Wild Magic Surge {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level3WildMagicSurge}

Your spellcasting can unleash surges of untamed magic. Once per turn, you can roll 1d20 immediately after you cast a Sorcerer spell with a spell slot. If you roll a 20, roll on the [Wild Magic Surge table](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:wildmagicsurge "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#wildmagicsurge") to create a magical effect.

If the magical effect is a spell, it is too wild to be affected by your Metamagic.

##### Level 3: Tides of Chaos {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level3TidesofChaos}

You can manipulate chaos itself to give yourself [**Advantage**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:advantage "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#advantage") on one [**D20 Test**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:d20test "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#d20test") before you roll the d20. Once you do so, you must cast a Sorcerer spell with a spell slot or finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest") before you can use this feature again.

If you do cast a Sorcerer spell with a spell slot before you finish a Long Rest, you automatically roll on the [Wild Magic Surge table](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:wildmagicsurge "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#wildmagicsurge").

[![Wild Magic Sorcery Subclass (Artist: EKATERINA BURMAK)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-026.wild-magic.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-026.wild-magic.png)

##### Level 6: Bend Luck {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level6BendLuck}

You have the ability to twist fate using your wild magic. Immediately after another creature you can see rolls the d20 for a [**D20 Test**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:d20test "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#d20test"), you can take a Reaction and spend 1 Sorcery Point to roll 1d4 and apply the number rolled as a bonus or penalty (your choice) to the d20 roll.

##### Level 14: Controlled Chaos {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level14ControlledChaos}

You gain a modicum of control over the surges of your wild magic. Whenever you roll on the [Wild Magic Surge table](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:wildmagicsurge "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#wildmagicsurge"), you can roll twice and use either number.

[![The Sorcerer Delina manipulates wild magic to create unpredictable wonders (Artist: WISNU TAN)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-027.delina.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-027.delina.png)

##### Level 18: Tamed Surge {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level18TamedSurge}

Immediately after you cast a Sorcerer spell with a spell slot, you can create an effect of your choice from the Wild Magic Surge table instead of rolling on that table. You can choose any effect in the table except for the final row, and if the chosen effect involves a roll, you must make it.

Once you use this feature, you can’t do so again until you finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest").

**Wild Magic Surge**

## Warlock {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Warlock}

[![An Occultist Empowered by Otherworldly Pacts (Artist: NÉSTOR OSSANDON LEAL)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-028.warlock.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-028.warlock.png)

**Core Warlock Traits**

| Primary Ability            | Charisma                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| -------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Hit Point Die              | D8 per Warlock level                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |

| Weapon Proficiencies       | Simple weapons                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Armor Training             | Light armor                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Starting Equipment         | _Choose A or B:_ (A) [**Leather Armor**](#ref:equipment:10-leather "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/10-leather"), [**Sickle**](#ref:equipment:13-sickle "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/13-sickle"), 2 [**Daggers**](#ref:equipment:3-dagger "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/3-dagger"), [**Arcane Focus**](#ref:equipment:544-arcane-focus "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/544-arcane-focus") ([**orb**](#ref:equipment:526-orb "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/526-orb")), [**Book**](#ref:equipment:439-book "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/439-book") (occult lore), [**Scholar’s Pack**](#ref:equipment:418-scholars-pack "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/418-scholars-pack"), and 15 GP; or (B) 100 GP |

Warlocks quest for knowledge that lies hidden in the fabric of the multiverse. They often begin their search for magical power by delving into tomes of forbidden lore, dabbling in invocations meant to attract the power of extraplanar beings, or seeking places of power where the influence of these beings can be felt. In no time, each Warlock is drawn into a binding pact with a powerful patron. Drawing on the ancient knowledge of beings such as angels, archfey, demons, devils, hags, and alien entities of the Far Realm, Warlocks piece together arcane secrets to bolster their own power.

Warlocks view their patrons as resources, as means to the end of achieving magical power. Some Warlocks respect, revere, or even love their patrons; some serve their patrons grudgingly; and some seek to undermine their patrons even as they wield the power their patrons have given them.

Once a pact is made, a Warlock’s thirst for knowledge and power can’t be slaked with mere study. Most Warlocks spend their days pursuing greater power and deeper knowledge, which typically means some kind of adventure.

#### Becoming a Warlock... {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:BecomingaWarlock}

##### As a Level 1 Character {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:AsaLevel1Character}

- Gain all the traits in the [Core Warlock Traits table](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:corewarlocktraits "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#corewarlocktraits").
- Gain the Warlock’s level 1 features, which are listed in the [Warlock Features table](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:warlockfeatures "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#warlockfeatures").

##### As a Multiclass Character {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:AsaMulticlassCharacter}

- Gain the following traits from the [Core Warlock Traits table](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:corewarlocktraits "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#corewarlocktraits"): Hit Point Die and training with Light armor.
- Gain the Warlock’s level 1 features, which are listed in the [Warlock Features table](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:warlockfeatures "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#warlockfeatures"). See the multiclassing rules in [chapter 2](#phb-2024:creating-a-character:Multiclassing "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/creating-a-character#Multiclassing") to determine your available spell slots.

#### Level 1: Eldritch Invocations {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level1EldritchInvocations}

You have unearthed Eldritch Invocations, pieces of forbidden knowledge that imbue you with an abiding magical ability or other lessons. You gain one invocation of your choice, such as [Pact of the Tome](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:pactofthetome "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#pactofthetome"). Invocations are described in the “[Eldritch Invocation Options](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:eldritchinvocationoptions "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#eldritchinvocationoptions")” section later in this class’s description.

**_Prerequisites._** If an invocation has a prerequisite, you must meet it to learn that invocation. For example, if an invocation requires you to be a level 5+ Warlock, you can select the invocation once you reach Warlock level 5.

**_Replacing and Gaining Invocations._** Whenever you gain a Warlock level, you can replace one of your invocations with another one for which you qualify. You can’t replace an invocation if it’s a prerequisite for another invocation that you have.

When you gain certain Warlock levels, you gain more invocations of your choice, as shown in the Invocations column of the [Warlock Features table](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:warlockfeatures "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#warlockfeatures").

You can’t pick the same invocation more than once unless its description says otherwise.

#### Level 1: Pact Magic {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level1PactMagic}

Through occult ceremony, you have formed a pact with a mysterious entity to gain magical powers. The entity is a voice in the shadows—its identity unclear—but its boon to you is concrete: the ability to cast spells. See [chapter 7](#phb-2024:spells "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/spells") for the rules on spellcasting. The information below details how you use those rules with Warlock spells, which appear in the [Warlock spell list](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:warlockspelllist "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#warlockspelllist") later in the class’s description.

**_Cantrips._** You know two Warlock cantrips of your choice. [**Eldritch Blast**](#ref:spell:2619161-eldritch-blast "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619161-eldritch-blast") and [**Prestidigitation**](#ref:spell:2618893-prestidigitation "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618893-prestidigitation") are recommended. Whenever you gain a Warlock level, you can replace one of your cantrips from this feature with another Warlock cantrip of your choice.

When you reach Warlock levels 4 and 10, you learn another Warlock cantrip of your choice, as shown in the Cantrips column of the [Warlock Features table](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:warlockfeatures "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#warlockfeatures").

**_Spell Slots._** The Warlock Features table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your Warlock spells of levels 1–5. The table also shows the level of those slots, all of which are the same level. You regain all expended Pact Magic spell slots when you finish a [**Short**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:shortrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#shortrest") or [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest").

For example, when you’re a level 5 Warlock, you have two level 3 spell slots. To cast the level 1 spell [**Witch Bolt**](#ref:spell:2619215-witch-bolt "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619215-witch-bolt"), you must spend one of those slots, and you cast it as a level 3 spell.

**_Prepared Spells of Level 1+._** You prepare the list of level 1+ spells that are available for you to cast with this feature. To start, choose two level 1 Warlock spells. [**Charm Person**](#ref:spell:2618964-charm-person "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618964-charm-person") and [**Hex**](#ref:spell:2618988-hex "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618988-hex") are recommended.

The number of spells on your list increases as you gain Warlock levels, as shown in the Prepared Spells column of the [Warlock Features table](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:warlockfeatures "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#warlockfeatures"). Whenever that number increases, choose additional Warlock spells until the number of spells on your list matches the number in the table. The chosen spells must be of a level no higher than what’s shown in the table’s Slot Level column for your level. When you reach level 6, for example, you learn a new Warlock spell, which can be of levels 1–3.

If another Warlock feature gives you spells that you always have prepared, those spells don’t count against the number of spells you can prepare with this feature, but those spells otherwise count as Warlock spells for you.

**_Changing Your Prepared Spells._** Whenever you gain a Warlock level, you can replace one spell on your list with another Warlock spell of an eligible level.

**_Spellcasting Ability._** Charisma is the spellcasting ability for your Warlock spells.

**_Spellcasting Focus._** You can use an [**Arcane Focus**](#ref:equipment:544-arcane-focus "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/544-arcane-focus") as a Spellcasting Focus for your Warlock spells.

#### Level 2: Magical Cunning {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level2MagicalCunning}

You can perform an esoteric rite for 1 minute. At the end of it, you regain expended Pact Magic spell slots but no more than a number equal to half your maximum (round up). Once you use this feature, you can’t do so again until you finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest").

#### Level 3: Warlock Subclass {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level3WarlockSubclass}

You gain a Warlock subclass of your choice. The [Archfey Patron](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:archfeypatron "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#archfeypatron"), [Celestial Patron](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:celestialpatron "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#celestialpatron"), [Fiend Patron](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:fiendpatron "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#fiendpatron"), and [Great Old One Patron](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:greatoldonepatron "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#greatoldonepatron") subclasses are detailed after this class’s description. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Warlock levels. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass’s features that are of your Warlock level or lower.

#### Level 4: Ability Score Improvement {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level4AbilityScoreImprovement}

You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat (see [chapter 5](#phb-2024:feats:abilityscoreimprovement "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/feats#abilityscoreimprovement")) or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at Warlock levels 8, 12, and 16.

#### Level 9: Contact Patron {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level9ContactPatron}

In the past, you usually contacted your patron through intermediaries. Now you can communicate directly; you always have the [**Contact Other Plane**](#ref:spell:2619052-contact-other-plane "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619052-contact-other-plane") spell prepared. With this feature, you can cast the spell without expending a spell slot to contact your patron, and you automatically succeed on the spell’s saving throw.

Once you cast the spell with this feature, you can’t do so in this way again until you finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest").

#### Level 11: Mystic Arcanum {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level11MysticArcanum}

Your patron grants you a magical secret called an arcanum. Choose one level 6 Warlock spell as this arcanum.

You can cast your arcanum spell once without expending a spell slot, and you must finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest") before you can cast it in this way again.

As shown in the [Warlock Features table](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:warlockfeatures "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#warlockfeatures"), you gain another Warlock spell of your choice that can be cast in this way when you reach Warlock levels 13 (level 7 spell), 15 (level 8 spell), and 17 (level 9 spell). You regain all uses of your Mystic Arcanum when you finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest").

[![(Artist: WAYNE ENGLAND)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-029.skull-spiders.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-029.skull-spiders.png)

Whenever you gain a Warlock level, you can replace one of your arcanum spells with another Warlock spell of the same level.

#### Level 19: Epic Boon {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level19EpicBoon}

You gain an Epic Boon feat (see [chapter 5](#phb-2024:feats:EpicBoonFeats "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/feats#EpicBoonFeats")) or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. [Boon of Fate](#phb-2024:feats:boonoffate "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/feats#boonoffate") is recommended.

#### Level 20: Eldritch Master {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level20EldritchMaster}

When you use your Magical Cunning feature, you regain all your expended Pact Magic spell slots.

### Eldritch Invocation Options {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:EldritchInvocationOptions}

Eldritch Invocation options appear in alphabetical order.

---

#### Agonizing Blast {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:AgonizingBlast}

_Prerequisite: Level 2+ Warlock, a Warlock Cantrip That Deals Damage_

Choose one of your known Warlock cantrips that deals damage. You can add your Charisma modifier to that spell’s damage rolls.

**_Repeatable._** You can gain this invocation more than once. Each time you do so, choose a different eligible cantrip.

---

#### Armor of Shadows {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:ArmorofShadows}

You can cast [**Mage Armor**](#ref:spell:2619006-mage-armor "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619006-mage-armor") on yourself without expending a spell slot.

---

#### Ascendant Step {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:AscendantStep}

_Prerequisite: Level 5+ Warlock_

You can cast [**Levitate**](#ref:spell:2618994-levitate "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618994-levitate") on yourself without expending a spell slot.

---

#### Devil’s Sight {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:DevilsSight}

_Prerequisite: Level 2+ Warlock_

You can see normally in [**Dim Light**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:dimlight "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#dimlight") and [**Darkness**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:darkness "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#darkness")—both magical and nonmagical—within 120 feet of yourself.

---

#### Devouring Blade {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:DevouringBlade}

_Prerequisite: Level 12+ Warlock, [Thirsting Blade](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:thirstingblade "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#thirstingblade") Invocation_

The Extra Attack of your Thirsting Blade invocation confers two extra attacks rather than one.

---

#### Eldritch Mind {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:EldritchMind}

You have [**Advantage**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:advantage "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#advantage") on Constitution saving throws that you make to maintain [**Concentration**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:concentration "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#concentration").

---

#### Eldritch Smite {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:EldritchSmite}

_Prerequisite: Level 5+ Warlock, [Pact of the Blade](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:pactoftheblade "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#pactoftheblade") Invocation_

Once per turn when you hit a creature with your pact weapon, you can expend a Pact Magic spell slot to deal an extra 1d8 Force damage to the target, plus another 1d8 per level of the spell slot, and you can give the target the [**Prone**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:pronecondition "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#pronecondition") condition if it is Huge or smaller.

---

#### Eldritch Spear {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:EldritchSpear}

_Prerequisite: Level 2+ Warlock, a Warlock Cantrip That Deals Damage_

Choose one of your known Warlock cantrips that deals damage and has a range of 10+ feet. When you cast that spell, its range increases by a number of feet equal to 30 times your Warlock level.

**_Repeatable._** You can gain this invocation more than once. Each time you do so, choose a different eligible cantrip.

---

#### Fiendish Vigor {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:FiendishVigor}

_Prerequisite: Level 2+ Warlock_

You can cast [**False Life**](#ref:spell:2618866-false-life "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618866-false-life") on yourself without expending a spell slot. When you cast the spell with this feature, you don’t roll the die for the [**Temporary Hit Points**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:temporaryhitpoints "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#temporaryhitpoints"); you automatically get the highest number on the die.

---

#### Gaze of Two Minds {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:GazeofTwoMinds}

_Prerequisite: Level 5+ Warlock_

You can use a Bonus Action to touch a willing creature and perceive through its senses until the end of your next turn. As long as the creature is on the same plane of existence as you, you can take a Bonus Action on subsequent turns to maintain this connection, extending the duration until the end of your next turn. The connection ends if you don’t maintain it in this way.

While perceiving through the other creature’s senses, you benefit from any special senses possessed by that creature, and you can cast spells as if you were in your space or the other creature’s space if the two of you are within 60 feet of each other.

---

#### Gift of the Depths {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:GiftoftheDepths}

_Prerequisite: Level 5+ Warlock_

You can breathe underwater, and you gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

You can also cast [**Water Breathing**](#ref:spell:2619205-water-breathing "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619205-water-breathing") once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to cast it in this way again when you finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest").

---

#### Gift of the Protectors {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:GiftoftheProtectors}

_Prerequisite: Level 9+ Warlock, [Pact of the Tome](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:pactofthetome "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#pactofthetome") Invocation_

A new page appears in your _Book of Shadows_ when you conjure it. With your permission, a creature can take an action to write its name on that page, which can contain a number of names equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one name).

When any creature whose name is on the page is reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, the creature magically drops to 1 Hit Point instead. Once this magic is triggered, no creature can benefit from it until you finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest").

As a [**Magic**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:magicaction "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#magicaction") action, you can erase a name on the page by touching it.

---

#### Investment of the Chain Master {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:InvestmentoftheChainMaster}

_Prerequisite: Level 5+ Warlock, [Pact of the Chain](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:pactofthechain "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#pactofthechain") Invocation_

When you cast [**Find Familiar**](#ref:spell:2618877-find-familiar "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618877-find-familiar"), you infuse the summoned familiar with a measure of your eldritch power, granting the creature the following benefits.

**_Aerial or Aquatic._** The familiar gains either a Fly Speed or a Swim Speed (your choice) of 40 feet.

**_Quick Attack._** As a Bonus Action, you can command the familiar to take the [**Attack**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:attackaction "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#attackaction") action.

**_Necrotic or Radiant Damage._** Whenever the familiar deals Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage, you can make it deal Necrotic or Radiant damage instead.

**_Your Save DC._** If the familiar forces a creature to make a saving throw, it uses your spell save DC.

**_Resistance._** When the familiar takes damage, you can take a Reaction to grant it Resistance against that damage.

---

#### Lessons of the First Ones {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:LessonsoftheFirstOnes}

_Prerequisite: Level 2+ Warlock_

You have received knowledge from an elder entity of the multiverse, allowing you to gain one Origin feat of your choice (see [chapter 5](#phb-2024:feats:OriginFeats "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/feats#OriginFeats")).

**_Repeatable._** You can gain this invocation more than once. Each time you do so, choose a different Origin feat.

---

#### Lifedrinker {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Lifedrinker}

_Prerequisite: Level 9+ Warlock, [Pact of the Blade](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:pactoftheblade "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#pactoftheblade") Invocation_

Once per turn when you hit a creature with your pact weapon, you can deal an extra 1d6 Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant damage (your choice) to the creature, and you can expend one of your Hit Point Dice to roll it and regain a number of Hit Points equal to the roll plus your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1 Hit Point).

---

#### Mask of Many Faces {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:MaskofManyFaces}

_Prerequisite: Level 2+ Warlock_

You can cast [**Disguise Self**](#ref:spell:2619102-disguise-self "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619102-disguise-self") without expending a spell slot.

---

#### Master of Myriad Forms {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:MasterofMyriadForms}

_Prerequisite: Level 5+ Warlock_

You can cast [**Alter Self**](#ref:spell:2618846-alter-self "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618846-alter-self") without expending a spell slot.

---

#### Misty Visions {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:MistyVisions}

_Prerequisite: Level 2+ Warlock_

You can cast [**Silent Image**](#ref:spell:2619062-silent-image "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619062-silent-image") without expending a spell slot.

---

#### One with Shadows {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:OnewithShadows}

_Prerequisite: Level 5+ Warlock_

While you’re in an area of [**Dim Light**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:dimlight "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#dimlight") or [**Darkness**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:darkness "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#darkness"), you can cast [**Invisibility**](#ref:spell:2619116-invisibility "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619116-invisibility") on yourself without expending a spell slot.

---

#### Otherworldly Leap {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:OtherworldlyLeap}

_Prerequisite: Level 2+ Warlock_

You can cast [**Jump**](#ref:spell:2618991-jump "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618991-jump") on yourself without expending a spell slot.

---

#### Pact of the Blade {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:PactoftheBlade}

As a Bonus Action, you can conjure a pact weapon in your hand—a Simple or Martial Melee weapon of your choice with which you bond—or create a bond with a magic weapon you touch; you can’t bond with a magic weapon if someone else is attuned to it or another Warlock is bonded with it. Until the bond ends, you have proficiency with the weapon, and you can use it as a Spellcasting Focus.

Whenever you attack with the bonded weapon, you can use your Charisma modifier for the attack and damage rolls instead of using Strength or Dexterity; and you can cause the weapon to deal Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant damage or its normal damage type.

Your bond with the weapon ends if you use this feature’s Bonus Action again, if the weapon is more than 5 feet away from you for 1 minute or more, or if you die. A conjured weapon disappears when the bond ends.

---

#### Pact of the Chain {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:PactoftheChain}

You learn the [**Find Familiar**](#ref:spell:2618877-find-familiar "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618877-find-familiar") spell and can cast it as a [**Magic**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:magicaction "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#magicaction") action without expending a spell slot.

When you cast the spell, you choose one of the normal forms for your familiar or one of the following special forms: [**Imp**](#ref:monster:4775825-imp "https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775825-imp"), [**Pseudodragon**](#ref:monster:4775834-pseudodragon "https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775834-pseudodragon"), [**Quasit**](#ref:monster:4775835-quasit "https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775835-quasit"), [**Skeleton**](#ref:monster:4775841-skeleton "https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775841-skeleton"), [**Slaad Tadpole**](#ref:monster:4775842-slaad-tadpole "https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775842-slaad-tadpole"), [**Sphinx of Wonder**](#ref:monster:4775843-sphinx-of-wonder "https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775843-sphinx-of-wonder"), [**Sprite**](#ref:monster:4775845-sprite "https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775845-sprite"), or [**Venomous Snake**](#ref:monster:4775847-venomous-snake "https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775847-venomous-snake") (see [appendix B](#phb-2024:creature-stat-blocks "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/creature-stat-blocks") for the familiar’s stat block).

Additionally, when you take the [**Attack**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:attackaction "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#attackaction") action, you can forgo one of your own attacks to allow your familiar to make one attack of its own with its Reaction.

---

#### Pact of the Tome {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:PactoftheTome}

Stitching together strands of shadow, you conjure forth a book in your hand at the end of a [**Short**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:shortrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#shortrest") or [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest"). This _Book of Shadows_ (you determine its appearance) contains eldritch magic that only you can access, granting you the benefits below. The book disappears if you conjure another book with this feature or if you die.

**_Cantrips and Rituals._** When the book appears, choose three cantrips, and choose two level 1 spells that have the Ritual tag. The spells can be from any class’s spell list, and they must be spells you don’t already have prepared. While the book is on your person, you have the chosen spells prepared, and they function as Warlock spells for you.

**_Spellcasting Focus._** You can use the book as a Spellcasting Focus.

---

#### Repelling Blast {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:RepellingBlast}

_Prerequisite: Level 2+ Warlock, a Warlock Cantrip That Deals Damage via an Attack Roll_

Choose one of your known Warlock cantrips that requires an attack roll. When you hit a Large or smaller creature with that cantrip, you can push the creature up to 10 feet straight away from you.

**_Repeatable._** You can gain this invocation more than once. Each time you do so, choose a different eligible cantrip.

---

#### Thirsting Blade {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:ThirstingBlade}

_Prerequisite: Level 5+ Warlock, [Pact of the Blade](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:pactoftheblade "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#pactoftheblade") Invocation_

You gain the Extra Attack feature for your pact weapon only. With that feature, you can attack twice with the weapon instead of once when you take the [**Attack**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:attackaction "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#attackaction") action on your turn.

---

#### Visions of Distant Realms {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:VisionsofDistantRealms}

_Prerequisite: Level 9+ Warlock_

You can cast [**Arcane Eye**](#ref:spell:2618863-arcane-eye "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618863-arcane-eye") without expending a spell slot.

---

#### Whispers of the Grave {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:WhispersoftheGrave}

_Prerequisite: Level 7+ Warlock_

You can cast [**Speak with Dead**](#ref:spell:2619068-speak-with-dead "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619068-speak-with-dead") without expending a spell slot.

---

#### Witch Sight {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:WitchSight}

_Prerequisite: Level 15+ Warlock_

You have [**Truesight**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:truesight "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#truesight") with a range of 30 feet.

### Warlock Spell List {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:WarlockSpellList}

This section presents the Warlock spell list. The spells are organized by spell level and then alphabetized, and each spell’s school of magic is listed. In the Special column, _C_ means the spell requires Concentration, _R_ means it’s a Ritual, and _M_ means it requires a specific Material component.

**Cantrips (Level 0 Warlock Spells)**

| Spell                                                                                                                   | School        | Special |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------- | ------- |
| [**Blade Ward**](#ref:spell:2618931-blade-ward "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618931-blade-ward")                   | Abjuration    | C       |
| [**Chill Touch**](#ref:spell:2618965-chill-touch "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618965-chill-touch")                | Necromancy    | —       |
| [**Eldritch Blast**](#ref:spell:2619161-eldritch-blast "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619161-eldritch-blast")       | Evocation     | —       |
| [**Friends**](#ref:spell:2618924-friends "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618924-friends")                            | Enchantment   | C       |

### Warlock Subclasses {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:WarlockSubclasses}

A Warlock subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Warlock levels, as specified in the subclass. This section presents the [Archfey Patron](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:archfeypatron "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#archfeypatron"), [Celestial Patron](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:celestialpatron "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#celestialpatron"), [Fiend Patron](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:fiendpatron "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#fiendpatron"), and [Great Old One Patron](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:greatoldonepatron "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#greatoldonepatron") subclasses.

#### Archfey Patron {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:ArchfeyPatron}

_Bargain with Whimsical Fey_

Your pact draws on the power of the Feywild. When you choose this subclass, you might make a deal with an archfey, such as the Prince of Frost; the Queen of Air and Darkness, ruler of the Gloaming Court; Titania of the Summer Court; or an ancient hag. Or you might call on a spectrum of Fey, weaving a web of favors and debts. Whoever they are, your patron is often inscrutable and whimsical.

[![Archfey Patron Subclass (Artist: ERION MAKUO)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-030.archfey-patron.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-030.archfey-patron.png)

##### Level 3: Archfey Spells {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level3ArchfeySpells}

The magic of your patron ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Warlock level specified in the Archfey Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

**Archfey Spells**

##### Level 3: Steps of the Fey {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level3StepsoftheFey}

Your patron grants you the ability to move between the boundaries of the planes. You can cast [**Misty Step**](#ref:spell:2619133-misty-step "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619133-misty-step") without expending a spell slot a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest").

In addition, whenever you cast that spell, you can choose one of the following additional effects.

**_Refreshing Step._** Immediately after you teleport, you or one creature you can see within 10 feet of yourself gains 1d10 [**Temporary Hit Points**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:temporaryhitpoints "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#temporaryhitpoints").

**_Taunting Step._** Creatures within 5 feet of the space you left must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or have [**Disadvantage**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:disadvantage "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#disadvantage") on attack rolls against creatures other than you until the start of your next turn.

##### Level 6: Misty Escape {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level6MistyEscape}

You can cast [**Misty Step**](#ref:spell:2619133-misty-step "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619133-misty-step") as a Reaction in response to taking damage.

In addition, the following effects are now among your Steps of the Fey options.

**_Disappearing Step._** You have the [**Invisible**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:invisiblecondition "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#invisiblecondition") condition until the start of your next turn or until immediately after you make an attack roll, deal damage, or cast a spell.

**_Dreadful Step._** Creatures within 5 feet of the space you left or the space you appear in (your choice) must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or take 2d10 Psychic damage.

##### Level 10: Beguiling Defenses {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level10BeguilingDefenses}

Your patron teaches you how to guard your mind and body. You are immune to the [**Charmed**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:charmedcondition "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#charmedcondition") condition.

In addition, immediately after a creature you can see hits you with an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to reduce the damage you take by half (round down), and you can force the attacker to make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the attacker takes Psychic damage equal to the damage you take. Once you use this Reaction, you can’t use it again until you finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest") unless you expend a Pact Magic spell slot (no action required) to restore your use of it.

##### Level 14: Bewitching Magic {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level14BewitchingMagic}

Your patron grants you the ability to weave your magic with teleportation. Immediately after you cast an Enchantment or Illusion spell using an action and a spell slot, you can cast [**Misty Step**](#ref:spell:2619133-misty-step "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619133-misty-step") as part of the same action and without expending a spell slot.

#### Celestial Patron {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:CelestialPatron}

_Call on the Power of the Heavens_

Your pact draws on the Upper Planes, the realms of everlasting bliss. You might enter an agreement with an empyrean, a couatl, a sphinx, a unicorn, or another heavenly entity. Or you might call on numerous such beings as you pursue goals aligned with theirs. Your pact allows you to experience a hint of the holy light that illuminates the multiverse.

| 9             | [**Greater Restoration**](#ref:spell:2618961-greater-restoration "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618961-greater-restoration"), [**Summon Celestial**](#ref:spell:2619108-summon-celestial "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619108-summon-celestial")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |

##### Level 3: Healing Light {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level3HealingLight}

You gain the ability to channel celestial energy to heal wounds. You have a pool of d6s to fuel this healing. The number of dice in the pool equals 1 plus your Warlock level.

As a Bonus Action, you can heal yourself or one creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself, expending dice from the pool. The maximum number of dice you can expend at once equals your Charisma modifier (minimum of one die). Roll the dice you expend, and restore a number of Hit Points equal to the roll’s total. Your pool regains all expended dice when you finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest").

[![Celestial Patron Subclass (Artist: EKATERINA BURMAK)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-031.celestial-patron.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-031.celestial-patron.png)

##### Level 6: Radiant Soul {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level6RadiantSoul}

Your link to your patron allows you to serve as a conduit for radiant energy. You have Resistance to Radiant damage. Once per turn, when a spell you cast deals Radiant or Fire damage, you can add your Charisma modifier to that spell’s damage against one of the spell’s targets.

##### Level 10: Celestial Resilience {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level10CelestialResilience}

You gain [**Temporary Hit Points**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:temporaryhitpoints "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#temporaryhitpoints") whenever you use your Magical Cunning feature or finish a [**Short**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:shortrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#shortrest") or [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest"). These Temporary Hit Points equal your Warlock level plus your Charisma modifier. Additionally, choose up to five creatures you can see when you gain the points. Those creatures each gain Temporary Hit Points equal to half your Warlock level plus your Charisma modifier.

##### Level 14: Searing Vengeance {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level14SearingVengeance}

When you or an ally within 60 feet of you is about to make a [**Death Saving Throw**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:deathsavingthrow "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#deathsavingthrow"), you can unleash radiant energy to save the creature. The creature regains Hit Points equal to half its Hit Point maximum and can end the [**Prone**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:pronecondition "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#pronecondition") condition on itself. Each creature of your choice that is within 30 feet of the creature takes Radiant damage equal to 2d8 plus your Charisma modifier, and each has the [**Blinded**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:blindedcondition "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#blindedcondition") condition until the end of the current turn.

Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest").

#### Fiend Patron {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:FiendPatron}

_Make a Deal with the Lower Planes_

Your pact draws on the Lower Planes, the realms of perdition. You might forge a bargain with a demon lord such as Demogorgon or Orcus; an archdevil such as Asmodeus; or a pit fiend, balor, yugoloth, or night hag that is especially mighty. That patron’s aims are evil—the corruption or destruction of all things, ultimately including you—and your path is defined by the extent to which you strive against those aims.

[![Fiend Patron Subclass (Artist: JODIE MUIR)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-032.fiend-patron.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-032.fiend-patron.png)

##### Level 3: Dark One’s Blessing {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level3DarkOnesBlessing}

When you reduce an enemy to 0 Hit Points, you gain [**Temporary Hit Points**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:temporaryhitpoints "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#temporaryhitpoints") equal to your Charisma modifier plus your Warlock level (minimum of 1 Temporary Hit Point). You also gain this benefit if someone else reduces an enemy within 10 feet of you to 0 Hit Points.

##### Level 3: Fiend Spells {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level3FiendSpells}

The magic of your patron ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Warlock level specified in the Fiend Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

**Fiend Spells**

| Warlock Level | Spells                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 3             | [**Burning Hands**](#ref:spell:2618946-burning-hands "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618946-burning-hands"), [**Command**](#ref:spell:2618985-command "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618985-command"), [**Scorching Ray**](#ref:spell:2619005-scorching-ray "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619005-scorching-ray"), [**Suggestion**](#ref:spell:2619101-suggestion "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619101-suggestion") |

##### Level 6: Dark One’s Own Luck {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level6DarkOnesOwnLuck}

You can call on your fiendish patron to alter fate in your favor. When you make an ability check or a saving throw, you can use this feature to add 1d10 to your roll. You can do so after seeing the roll but before any of the roll’s effects occur.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of once), but you can use it no more than once per roll. You regain all expended uses when you finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest").

##### Level 10: Fiendish Resilience {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level10FiendishResilience}

Choose one damage type, other than Force, whenever you finish a [**Short**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:shortrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#shortrest") or [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest"). You have Resistance to that damage type until you choose a different one with this feature.

##### Level 14: Hurl Through Hell {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level14HurlThroughHell}

Once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can try to instantly transport the target through the Lower Planes. The target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw against your spell save DC, or the target disappears and hurtles through a nightmare landscape. The target takes 8d10 Psychic damage if it isn’t a Fiend, and it has the [**Incapacitated**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:incapacitatedcondition "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#incapacitatedcondition") condition until the end of your next turn, when it returns to the space it previously occupied or the nearest unoccupied space.

Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest") unless you expend a Pact Magic spell slot (no action required) to restore your use of it.

#### Great Old One Patron {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:GreatOldOnePatron}

_Unearth Forbidden Lore of Ineffable Beings_

When you choose this subclass, you might bind yourself to an unspeakable being from the Far Realm or an elder god—a being such as Tharizdun, the Chained God; Zargon, the Returner; Hadar, the Dark Hunger; or Great Cthulhu. Or you might invoke several entities without yoking yourself to one. The motives of these beings are incomprehensible, and the Great Old One might be indifferent to your existence. But the secrets you’ve learned nevertheless allow you to draw strange magic from it.

##### Level 3: Awakened Mind {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level3AwakenedMind}

You can form a telepathic connection between your mind and the mind of another. As a Bonus Action, choose one creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself. You and the chosen creature can communicate telepathically with each other while the two of you are within a number of miles of each other equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1 mile). To understand each other, you each must mentally use a language the other knows.

The telepathic connection lasts for a number of minutes equal to your Warlock level. It ends early if you use this feature to connect with a different creature.

##### Level 3: Great Old One Spells {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level3GreatOldOneSpells}

The magic of your patron ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Warlock level specified in the Great Old One Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

[![Great Old One Patron Subclass (Artist: MAGALI VILLENEUVE)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-033.great-old-one-patron.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-033.great-old-one-patron.png)

##### Level 3: Psychic Spells {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level3PsychicSpells}

When you cast a Warlock spell that deals damage, you can change its damage type to Psychic. In addition, when you cast a Warlock spell that is an Enchantment or Illusion, you can do so without Verbal or Somatic components.

##### Level 6: Clairvoyant Combatant {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level6ClairvoyantCombatant}

When you form a telepathic bond with a creature using your Awakened Mind, you can force that creature to make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the creature has [**Disadvantage**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:disadvantage "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#disadvantage") on attack rolls against you, and you have [**Advantage**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:advantage "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#advantage") on attack rolls against that creature for the duration of the bond.

Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a [**Short**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:shortrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#shortrest") or [**Long Rest**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:longrest "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#longrest") unless you expend a Pact Magic spell slot (no action required) to restore your use of it.

##### Level 10: Eldritch Hex {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level10EldritchHex}

Your alien patron grants you a powerful curse. You always have the [**Hex**](#ref:spell:2618988-hex "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618988-hex") spell prepared. When you cast _Hex_ and choose an ability, the target also has [**Disadvantage**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:disadvantage "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#disadvantage") on saving throws of the chosen ability for the duration of the spell.

##### Level 10: Thought Shield {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level10ThoughtShield}

Your thoughts can’t be read by telepathy or other means unless you allow it. You also have Resistance to Psychic damage, and whenever a creature deals Psychic damage to you, that creature takes the same amount of damage that you take.

##### Level 14: Create Thrall {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Level14CreateThrall}

When you cast [**Summon Aberration**](#ref:spell:2619105-summon-aberration "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2619105-summon-aberration"), you can modify it so that it doesn’t require [**Concentration**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:concentration "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#concentration"). If you do so, the spell’s duration becomes 1 minute for that casting, and when summoned, the Aberration has a number of [**Temporary Hit Points**](#phb-2024:rules-glossary:temporaryhitpoints "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/rules-glossary#temporaryhitpoints") equal to your Warlock level plus your Charisma modifier.

In addition, the first time each turn the Aberration hits a creature under the effect of your [**Hex**](#ref:spell:2618988-hex "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2618988-hex"), the Aberration deals extra Psychic damage to the target equal to the bonus damage of that spell.

## Wizard {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:Wizard}

[![A Scholarly Magic-User of Arcane Power (Artist: BILLY CHRISTIAN)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-034.wizard.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/phb/MKDHZ1nxSXDDLOw2/04-034.wizard.png)

**Core Wizard Traits**

| Saving Throw Proficiencies | Intelligence and Wisdom                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |

| Starting Equipment         | _Choose A or B:_ (A) 2 [**Daggers**](#ref:equipment:3-dagger "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/3-dagger"), [**Arcane Focus**](#ref:equipment:544-arcane-focus "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/544-arcane-focus") ([**Quarterstaff**](#ref:equipment:12-quarterstaff "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/12-quarterstaff")), [**Robe**](#ref:equipment:412-robe "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/412-robe"), Spellbook, [**Scholar’s Pack**](#ref:equipment:418-scholars-pack "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/418-scholars-pack"), and 5 GP; or (B) 55 GP                                                                                         |

Wizards are defined by their exhaustive study of magic’s inner workings. They cast spells of explosive fire, arcing lightning, subtle deception, and spectacular transformations. Their magic conjures monsters from other planes of existence, glimpses the future, or forms protective barriers. Their mightiest spells change one substance into another, call meteors from the sky, or open portals to other worlds.

Most Wizards share a scholarly approach to magic. They examine the theoretical underpinnings of magic, particularly the categorization of spells into schools of magic. Renowned Wizards such as Bigby, Tasha, Mordenkainen, and Yolande have built on their studies to invent iconic spells now used across the multiverse.

The closest a Wizard is likely to come to an ordinary life is working as a sage or lecturer. Other Wizards sell their services as advisers, serve in military forces, or pursue lives of crime or domination.

But the lure of knowledge calls even the most unadventurous Wizards from the safety of their libraries and laboratories and into crumbling ruins and lost cities. Most Wizards believe that their counterparts in ancient civilizations knew secrets of magic that have been lost to the ages, and discovering those secrets could unlock the path to a power greater than any magic available in the present age.

#### Becoming a Wizard... {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:BecomingaWizard}

##### As a Level 1 Character {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:AsaLevel1Character}

- Gain all the traits in the [Core Wizard Traits table](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:corewizardtraits "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#corewizardtraits").
- Gain the Wizard’s level 1 features, which are listed in the [Wizard Features table](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:wizardfeatures "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#wizardfeatures").

##### As a Multiclass Character {#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:AsaMulticlassCharacter}

- Gain the Hit Point Die from the [Core Wizard Traits table](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:corewizardtraits "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#corewizardtraits").
- Gain the Wizard’s level 1 features, which are listed in the [Wizard Features table](#phb-2024:character-classes-continued:wizardfeatures "https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/phb-2024/character-classes-continued#wizardfeatures"). See the multiclassing rules in chapter 2 to determine your available spell slots.
